description: This file contains SQL statements for enabling Row Level Security policies and functions for access control in a Postgres database for a cloud resource management platform. It defines policies for various tables like profiles, providers, resources, monitoring metrics, notifications, billing, invoices, audit logs, and user roles, including helper functions for role checking and user identification.

methods.name: public.is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the current JWT claims indicate an admin role.

methods.name: public.current_user_id
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's UUID based on JWT claims.

calls: select 1 from public.resources r where r.id = monitoring_metrics.resource_id and (r.user_id = public.current_user_id() or public.is_admin())
